items.question: The ribbed panel field has the colour shown on the slide on every facade.
The band/frame around the panel field (corners, top and bottom edging) has the colour shown on the slide.
The plinth/base at and below the ground line (red line in the renders) has the colour shown on the slide.
Facade N: the number of vertical ribs/seams equals the slide (within 10 %).
Facade S: the number of vertical ribs/seams equals the slide (within 10 %).
Facade W: the number of vertical ribs/seams equals the slide (within 10 %).
Facade E: the number of vertical ribs/seams equals the slide (within 10 %).
A thin dark outline runs along the edge of the panel field, as on the slide.
Doors: same facade, position, size and colour as on the slide (none if the slide has none).
Windows: same facade, position, size, frame colour as on the slide (none if none).
No element, seam, hole, missing face or stretched texture that the slide does not show.
The NPM iso view shows the same colours and pattern as the VPM iso view.

missing.reason: All surfaces are default grey; no material or texture applied.

base_color.reason: Slide's blue panel colour is absent; the model is uniformly grey.

borders.reason: No finish borders; one grey tone everywhere.

scale.reason: No ribs or panel texture visible to judge; the slide's seam grid is missing.

finish.reason: Flat untextured grey; does not match the slide's panel finish.

consistency.reason: VPM and NPM match, but only because both are equally untextured.
